instruction: Grab the hand-sized wireless mouse and set it on the Yellow mat.

source.instruction: Grab the hand-sized wireless mouse and set it on the Yellow mat.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the mouse, which was at x = +8 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above the mouse at (9, -5, 94) and point downward.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-22, +14, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (9, -5, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw by +55 degrees to align with mouse orientation and lower to z=86 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (9, -5, 86) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Descend right gripper to grasp height z=78 cm around the mouse.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +0, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -5, 78) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper to grasp the mouse.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse; closed the gripper (opening 0.46: holding the mouse)

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -5, 78) opening 0.46; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift mouse up to z=88 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -5, 87) opening 0.47; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm horizontally to (23, -10, 88) directly above the yellow mat.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+15, -5, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (23, -10, 88) opening 0.47; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm slightly toward the yellow mat.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -3) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (23, -10, 84) opening 0.47; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower mouse onto the yellow mat (z=78 cm) and release gripper.
